artworks.title: The Abduction of Helena
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene depicting conflict and capture. The image shows several figures engaged in a dynamic and tense scene, with visible action and interaction among them. Some figures are in the act of carrying or dragging others, suggesting a struggle or abduction. The figures are drawn in an intricate style, with detailed musculature and expressive poses, set against a textured background. The composition contains an inscription with the words "RAPTVS" and "HELENA." The use of contrast in the shading emphasizes the figures' forms and movement across the narrow horizontal space.

artworks.title: The Judgment of Paris
artworks.description: The image depicts multiple figures in a historical setting. Five bodies are shown, mostly in full view. In the foreground, a seated man with curly hair and a beard is holding a curved object and is partially draped below the waist. To his left, a standing man with Roman-style armor, including a helmet, is depicted. He carries a staff with two snakes twisted around it. Three standing women are seen adjacent to him, depicted as nude, with their hair styled in buns; they are arranged in a line. In the upper right corner, a small winged figure is also visible, holding a bow while looking downward at the scene. The background features textured stone structures or formations, and there is an inscription at the bottom reading "IVDICIVM PARIDIS". The overall tone and style suggest a classical or mythological theme, rendered in a finely detailed, monochromatic fashion.

artworks.title: Venus and Cupid
artworks.description: The image shows two winged figures. The first figure is tall, standing upright and looking down to the side. They have flowing hair and gentle facial expressions. The second figure is smaller, positioned in front of the first, reaching up to touch them. The child's eyes are covered with a cloth, and they carry a quiver of arrows. Both figures are unclothed. The scene is set on a cloud-like base with a dark, crosshatched background. In the lower right corner, there is an ornate plaque with the inscription "AVDACES VENVS. IPSA IVVAT." and the initials "ISP".

artworks.title: Venus and Cupid
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length depiction of a nude figure standing with a relaxed posture. The person holds a long spear upright in one hand, while the other hand rests against the side, partially draped with a flowing robe or cloth. The figure's facial features display a serene expression with closed eyes and defined features, and the hair is styled with a wreath of leaves or flowers. Standing by the person's leg is a small winged figure holding a bow and looking up at the larger figure. The cherub is positioned on a swirling, cloud-like formation. The background consists of an abstract, textured pattern suggesting depth and space, with the initials "ISB" visible in a rectangular frame at the top left of the image.

artworks.title: Genius on a Dolphin
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper half of a chubby, cherubic child sitting down. The child's head is turned slightly to the right, with its eyes closed and features such as full cheeks, a small, slightly open mouth, and short, curly hair. The child is nude, with its right hand placed on a large, dog-like head it is seated upon, and its left hand holding a long staff. There are no visible accessories besides the creature and the staff. The background consists of closely spaced, horizontal lines, creating a textured, shaded effect. In the top left corner, the date "1521" and the letters "I S P" are inscribed.

artworks.title: Genius on a Dolphin, Riding to the Right
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a cherubic figure seated on a fantastical creature with a dragon-like appearance. The cherub has short, curly hair and is depicted holding a stick in their right hand. The creature has features like wings and a coiled tail. In the background, there is minimal detail with faint cross-hatching, and another winged element is visible. An inscription in the top right corner reads "1523" with a monogram "I. s. P". The engraving is on a plain, light-toned surface with slight discoloration and a mark at the bottom right edge.

artworks.title: Frieze with Centaurs
artworks.description: This is a drawing of centaurs and decorative elements. The drawing features four centaurs positioned symmetrically around plant motifs. The centaurs are depicted in a stance that suggests movement, with their tails and limbs posed. Floral patterns are interspersed between the figures, and the scene is framed by ornamental swirls and leaves. The visual style is reminiscent of Renaissance art, emphasizing intricate details and symmetry.

artworks.title: Battle Scene, with Castor and Pollux Abducting the Daughters of Leukippos
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two centaurs in a confrontation with a human-like figure standing between them. The figure is holding a club-like object. The centaurs are rearing up on their hind legs, with one holding a tree branch-like weapon and the other aiming a bow and arrow. The background is neutral. The drawing shows detailed musculature, hair, and fur, rendered with precise line work in a style influenced by classical European art.

artworks.title: Lichas Presenting Nessus' Tunic to Hercules
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting two muscular, classical male figures standing in front of architectural structures. The figures wear ancient Roman-style attire and are positioned on a tiled platform with grand structures featuring columns and arches in the background. One figure holds a club and draped lion skin over his arm, while the other carries a large piece of cloth. In the background, two smaller figures are shown in motion. The composition is detailed, with intricate line work and architectural elements typical of classical illustrations. There is text at the top right corner of the image.

artworks.title: Hercules Carrying the Columns of Gades
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure carrying a large column in an architectural setting. The back of a muscular individual is shown lifting the column, situated in a courtyard with classical architectural elements like arches and columns. In the background is a detailed cityscape with buildings, including a dome and towers. Various inscriptions and ornamental details are present, contributing to the classical theme. The composition conveys a sense of effort and grandeur, portrayed with linework and shading.

artworks.title: Hercules Killing Antaeus
artworks.description: The image depicts two muscular figures in a dynamic pose among rocks and a tree. An inscription in Latin appears at the top. The scene conveys a sense of tension and struggle.

artworks.title: Satyr Playing the Lyre
artworks.description: The image shows a mythical creature, likely a satyr, depicted in a seated position on a stone block. The satyr's full body is visible, with a muscular upper torso covered in fur-like texture, transitioning into goat-like legs with hooves. The creature is positioned in profile, facing to the right, and is playing a lyre, which is held with both hands. The satyr has a prominent facial structure with a broad nose, thick eyebrows, and a pronounced brow. Its hair is curly and unruly, with pointed ears emerging from the curls. No clothing is visible, highlighting its half-man, half-goat form. The background consists of tall, stylized grasses or reeds. In the top left corner of the image, there is a small, rectangular banner containing the initials "ISB." The overall composition is richly detailed with crosshatching and intricate line work.

artworks.title: Satyr Sounding a Horn
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a scene involving a central figure with features resembling a satyr, accompanied by smaller satyr-like creatures interacting playfully. Various elements such as grasses, foliage, and grapes are included in the scene. The drawing showcases intricate details and shading techniques reminiscent of classical and mythological themes often seen in Renaissance art. Crosshatching is used to provide depth and texture. The initials "ISB" are visible in the top right corner as a possible indication of the artist.

artworks.title: Leda and the Swan
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a nude figure interacting with a swan in a natural setting. The image depicts a seated, nude figure beside a swan, set in an outdoor scene with trees and, in the background, a detailed depiction of a castle or large building structure. The figure is positioned to the right, with flowing hair, and appears to be engaged with the swan, with an arm draped around it. The swan has its long neck arched elegantly. The detailed line work and shading provide depth and texture to the figures and the environment, demonstrating skilled draftsmanship. The scene is surrounded by natural elements and an architectural structure on the horizon. The style is reminiscent of Renaissance engraving techniques.

artworks.title: Saturn
artworks.description: The drawing shows a figure resembling a satyr, with a child in one arm and holding a goat's horn in the other. A goat sits at their feet. In the background, another figure leans over a jug. The style features fine lines and detailed cross-hatching for texture and depth, with careful attention to shading and contours. The image is labeled "SATVRNVS" and has the initials "ISB" in the corner. The composition is balanced, with the figures in the foreground and minimal background elements.

artworks.title: Jupiter
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an armor-clad warrior figure standing over a mythical sea creature amidst architectural ruins. The warrior figure holds a large sword in one hand and a shield in the other, donning a helmet adorned with ram-like horns, a short pleated skirt, and a flowing cape. The lower part of the drawing shows a hybrid creature with the upper body and head of a human and the lower body of a fish. The ground on which the figure stands is adorned with two fish, and the background features ruins of ancient architectural blocks. The drawing includes inscriptions and symbols adjacent to the figures.

artworks.title: Mars
artworks.description: The image shows a figure in an armor suit, holding a pole weapon and a curved sword. The person has a stern expression, a mustache, and a helmet. The armor includes a segmented plate around the waist and knee guards. There are celestial and mythological elements in the background, including a comet, the symbol of Mars, a ram, and a scorpion. The background has a textured surface.

artworks.title: Sun
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crowned figure holding a sun-faced staff and standing over a lion. The scene depicts a crowned individual holding a tall staff with a radiant sun that has a human face. The figure stands barefoot upon a lion, whose face expresses a human-like expression. On the upper left, there are inscriptions that include the number "4" and the word "SOL". The detailed cross-hatching and inkwork give the drawing a classic, symbolic appearance.

artworks.title: Venus
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing in a side profile position. The person's face is in profile with clear features and their hair is styled back with fabric or ribbon-like extensions flowing behind. They are wearing a draped garment and hold a burning heart in one hand and a spear or staff in the other. The person stands above a reclining cow, near a basket. In the background, there is a simple landscape with trees, shrubs, and what appears to be a body of water visible in the distance. The word "VENVS" is inscribed at the top of the image, along with symbols that may be astrological or symbolic references.

artworks.title: Mercury
artworks.description: The image displays a person standing in a regal position. The person is wearing a helmet with wing-like projections on top and a classical short tunic, cinched at the waist, with a cloak fastened at the shoulder. Their face is turned slightly to the side, with distinct facial features, comprising sharp eyes and a defined jawline. The individual has short hair peeking out from beneath the helmet. They are holding a caduceus in their left hand, a staff with two serpents intertwined, and small wings at the top. A sea creature with a human upper body and a fish-like lower half, holds a flower at the person's feet. Two cherubic figures are playfully interacting at the person's side. The background includes Latin inscriptions and astrological symbols, with a plain textured backdrop extending behind the figures.

artworks.title: Moon
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body depiction of a woman standing and facing slightly to the side with her head turned toward the viewer. She holds a crescent moon in her left hand and a staff in her right hand. Her facial features include detailed eyes and a slightly curved mouth, with long wavy hair falling around her shoulders. She wears a cloth around her lower body, a belt around her waist, and is barefoot. She stands on what appears to be a large lobster or crustacean. In the background, there is a small bush to her left and a structure made of rectangular stone blocks to her right, with grass and foliage growing beside it. The word "LUNA" and a crescent moon appear in the upper left corner, with the date "1539" and initials or a monogram "ISB" on the right side of the image.

artworks.title: Allegory of Christianity
artworks.description: The image shows a winged figure standing in a contrapposto pose. They have a calm expression, intricate hair with a leaf crown, and wear draped classical attire. They hold a heart emitting sun rays in their left hand and a staff in their right hand. A snake is at their feet. The background shows a paved area with sparse vegetation. Inscriptions are present in the image.

artworks.title: Fides (Faith)
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body depiction of a figure standing on a snake, with only their toes visible on the creature as it coils beneath them. The figure stands in a contrapposto stance, with their weight shifted onto one leg, and their head is slightly tilted to one side. The person's facial features are softly delineated, and they have short, somewhat curly hair adorned with a laurel wreath. They are wearing a long, flowing robe with drape-like folds, and two large wings extend from their back. The figure is holding a chalice in their right hand, with a wafer positioned above it, while their left hand holds a long, slender cross. Positioned in the background, behind the figure's right shoulder, is a tablet inscribed with several lines of text. The background appears to be a simple textured surface, possibly resembling stone, that provides contrast to the central figure. The word "FIDES" is visible on the left side of the image.
